items.title: Virginia Woolf : Un lieu à soi, une voix pour toutes

items.original_title: Lonely Boy Goes To a Rave
items.overview: A social recluse finally gets a chance with his crush.
items.title: Lonely Boy Goes To a Rave

items.overview: A sensitive teen falls for his masculine brother's girlfriend.
items.title: Chronic

items.overview: A melancholic office worker is confronted by a gaggle of magical creatures.
items.title: Creatureland

items.original_title: Let’s Build a Shelter for the Beaver Population on Campus!
items.overview: Two offbeat college students go on a quest to pay back the local beaver population.
items.title: Let’s Build a Shelter for the Beaver Population on Campus!

items.overview: Two chairs run away from society and decide to live in nature...
items.title: Chair, Chair

items.overview: Juan rescues a young woman in trouble, never suspecting that this single act will drag him back into the depths of his past.
items.title: Expiación

items.overview: A summer in rural France. Fourteen-year-old Marion urges her brother and his friends to confront a young group of nomadic travelers who have just settled on the outskirts of their village. But when she meets fifteen-year-old Wendy, an unexpected bond destabilizes her, challenging her perceptions and arousing emotions she struggles to understand.
items.title: Au loin

items.overview: With neither villains nor heroes, Enthéorie takes place in a wondrous elsewhere, where a hero, accompanied by his horse-headed squire, sets out in search of a princess he believes he must rescue. Through the conventions of a fairy tale, the film explores determinism, free will, and the roles assigned to us.
items.title: Enthéorie

items.overview: Harold Milton, a fiercely independent rancher, is enraged when expanding AI data centers contaminate his land and water, killing his livestock and threatening his family’s livelihood. After confronting the development company CEO, Arthur Irwin, and discovering that they intend to proceed despite the harm, Harold finds himself increasingly isolated as neighboring ranchers accept lucrative buyouts. When Arthur and his security team are involved in a violent confrontation with Harold’s ranch hand, Harold decides that peaceful resistance is no longer enough. Armed with explosives and firearms, Harold is forced to take a stand before they take everything.
items.title: The Holdout

items.overview: What if we woke up from the collective hypnosis that keeps us forever tense and striving for unreachable aesthetic ideals? What if we reclaimed our real bodies, left outside the frame? Oscena is a visionary journey of images and sounds through the battlefield that is the female body. A manifesto film, political and poetic, that turns the gaze back on the body: a space to inhabit, to desire and, finally, to set free.
items.title: Oscena

items.overview: As CANAL+ pays tribute to the 80s, Kyan Khojandi is hosting a new special show to celebrate this colorful decade with many guests.
items.title: Sixty-eighties

items.overview: Mia and Baxter learn what it truly takes to be Italian at the Norton St Italian Festa.
items.title: Tangenziale

items.overview: A naive young man must overcome fear in pursuit of instinct for a girl he sees everyday.
items.title: In Passing

items.original_title: Where Did You Sleep Last Night?
items.overview: Since his parents’ divorce, Andrea, a young man of Sri Lankan descent living in Naples, has been suffering from severe episodes of sleepwalking. He wakes up in different places across the city in the middle of the night, having no idea how he got there.
items.title: Where Did You Sleep Last Night?

items.overview: In a documentary, every image reflects the subjectivity of the one who creates it. In Una distanza siderale, Noemi Forti transforms this awareness into narration: the footage of a performance by Thomas Valerio, artist and co-writer of this film, conceals a relationship. The attention devoted to the performance coexists with the love and fear that permeate every image.
items.title: Una distanza siderale

items.original_title: Non è la fine del mondo
items.overview: A volcano erupts; black clouds fill the sky. The end of the world is getting closer, or perhaps it is just an illusion. Francesco Mastroleo counters this apocalyptic atmosphere by interviewing Neapolitan women at the Virtual Archeological Museum in Ercolano.
items.title: Non è la fine del mondo

items.overview: You can observe a surface and look at what it is visible or at what it conceals. In In superficie, Gianfranco Piazza retraces, through archival footage, the expedition of Italian geologists sent to Iran in 1959 in search of oil. From above, among the clouds, the images gradually descend toward hills, houses and empty roads.
items.title: In superficie

items.original_title: A Primeira Vez A Gente Nunca Esquece
items.title: A Primeira Vez A Gente Nunca Esquece

items.overview: A young woman scrolls through her desktop and finds her childhood filmed in VHS by her mother, until that gaze disappears. What remains are files on computers: a girl growing up under the watch of her PCs searching for approval.
items.title: Briciola!

items.original_title: Asterione percorre in bici tutte le rotonde di Caravaggio, (BG), 24043
items.overview: In Greek mythology, Asterion is one of the names given to the Minotaur, a creature hidden in the labyrinth of Crete. Andrés Testa Herranz and Giacomo Colombo bring the myth to the Po Valley: a figure wearing a bulky paper mask rides a bicycle through the roundabouts of Caravaggio.
items.title: Asterione percorre in bici tutte le rotonde di Caravaggio, (BG), 24043

items.original_title: Where the Air Tastes Like the Sea
items.overview: After a long winter of competitions, expeditions and personal setbacks, four Arc'teryx athletes trade fixed plans for fifteen days aboard a small sailboat in Northern Norway. Chasing ski lines through unpredictable weather, they soon realize the trip has little to do with perfect conditions. Living shoulder to shoulder and moving at the pace of the wind, they rediscover the joy of slowing down, embracing uncertainty, and finding freedom in the simplest moments.
items.title: Where the Air Tastes Like the Sea

items.original_title: The First Five Minutes... The Title Design Legacy of Dan Perri
items.overview: An in-depth exploration into the life of Dan Perri, the man who created titles for some of the most iconic movies of all time.
items.title: The First Five Minutes... The Title Design Legacy of Dan Perri

items.overview: At seventeen, HSU I-NING drifts into a precarious, power-unequal relationship with her teacher, HSUEH, and meets a mysterious BOY freeing a pomelo from a car on the same night. Ten years later, trapped in a stifling marriage, she reunites with the same mysterious boy. After her husband vanishes, I-Ning returns to the rooftop, where burning pomelo peel reignites her lost self.
items.title: Brighter Than Fire

items.overview: A moth leads a young girl into the woods, where she discovers a huge cocoon, its dust causing her metamorphosis. Shot on 16 & 8mm and hand-processed with nettles from Cornish woodlands, this film is imbued with the landscape in which it was made.
items.title: Moth Wood

items.overview: A woman travels through the Northeastern United States, gradually engaging with modernism and paintings from the 19th century.
items.title: Historic Sites
LIM YOUNG WOONG | IM HERO THE STADIUM 2

items.overview: Eun Woo infiltrates the palace to kill Crown Prince Lee Hyun, only to fall in love with him.
items.title: Wild Eyes: The Woman of the Prince

items.overview: A discord mod makes a team to steal GTA VI in order to save his grandma's life.
items.title: Cyberleek: Origins

items.overview: A thriller-satire about how hurtful stereotypes can be.
items.title: Shades of Darkness

items.overview: A young drag queen falls asleep. Her dreams take shape above her face: she dreams of herself bringing her future show to life.
items.title: TechnoChimères

items.overview: For 45-year-old artist Sarah, this is not a hypothetical issue. With her parents' 50th wedding anniversary approaching, they give her an ultimatum: she has one month to leave the family home. After a lifetime of being protected and supported by them, Sarah is suddenly expected to become independent. And there is one bizarre condition: if she ever wants to return, she must have a child to carry on the family line.
items.title: One Month

items.overview: Vibrant, colorful, and warm portrait of 47-year-old Sonia, who wants to leave her life as a sex worker behind and find a different means of making a living—no easy task in Madagascar, one of the poorest countries in the world, but Sonia is determined.
items.title: Mangabangabaka

items.overview: Twelve-year-old Kallpa has one big dream: to be chosen as Ñusta, the sacred princess in her Andean community's Winter Solstice Festival. However, she is barred from taking part because she was born in the body of a boy. As rigid traditions and growing rejection push her out, Kallpa finds a new home and family among a group of local trans women. Even while facing harsh prejudice, this close-knit group wraps Kallpa in real warmth and tenderness, giving her the room to figure out who she is and learn to love herself. Her journey becomes a quiet, resilient fight to live life on her own terms.
items.title: Princess

items.overview: Paris, June 2024. It's summer, it's Pride, but Maël is getting ghosted and Emilie just got dumped. Luckily, somewhere in the crowd, Maël meets Emilie and Emilie meets Maël.
items.title: sad pride generation

items.overview: After going through a period of anxiety, successful Irish comedian Chris Kent decides to forgo the internet in an attempt to reconnect with his family- all whilst writing a new show
items.title: Chris Kent Goes Offline

items.overview: Private Investigator Donald Anderson is hired to follow a woman believed to be having an  affair, but when he sees something that defies all explanation, his grasp on reality slips. The  further he gets in his investigation, the thinner the line between the real and the surreal  becomes.
items.title: Gomorrah

items.overview: A surprise birthday celebration turns into a waking nightmare when an enigmatic clown transforms a gathering of old friends into a series of disturbing performances, forcing each of them to confront the darkest truths they've hidden from one another.
items.title: Andoy

items.overview: A man unexpectedly meets his first love — a woman who died in a car accident three years earlier. Realising the past and present have become intertwined, he takes her on an impossible journey across Mongolia.
items.title: Snow in June

items.overview: When the Great Darkness returns to consume the world, Matilda, the daughter of the legendary King Adler, must journey through a realm swallowed by death and corruption. Armed only with her father's stories and an unbreakable will, she challenges an ancient force that has claimed countless lives, refusing to accept that death is the end.
items.title: She Who Refused Death

items.overview: The Fable of the Oplose follows two coworkers, Kellen and Rose, as they navigate life between shifts at a local restaurant. The story follows the 'magic' that holds the service industry together, exploring the tension of a workplace romance.
items.title: The Fable of the Oplose

items.overview: February 2026: Nerea, a young dreamer, arrives in the city where she meets Sael. Through voice memos recorded on the underground, streets and buildings, Nerea reflects on our place as human beings in the world. Nerea’s message will fall into Sael’s hands, thrown from the top of a skyscraper.
items.title: Vagar

items.overview: One chaotic, wild night in the streets of Cairo. The story revolves around a young man who is fiercely determined to chase his dream of becoming an entrepreneur and starting his own business. Alongside his friend and his cousin, his ambitious plans take an unexpected turn when their paths cross with a local taxi driver.
items.title: The Night Was Completely Ruined

items.overview: To avoid losing custody of her six-year-old daughter in Manila, Luz, an undocumented Filipina cleaner working in a luxury Swiss ski resort, must earn money at any cost – even if it means transgressing her own moral limits.
items.title: Enjoy Your Stay

items.overview: The beloved opera star Montserrat Caballé faces a challenge that takes her back to the beginning of her career.
items.title: Caballé

items.overview: Chronicles Shantaram Rajaram Vankudre, aka V. Shantaram, on his remarkable journey from the silent era through the advent of sound and colour, showcasing his evolution as one of India’s most influential filmmakers.
items.title: V. Shantaram

items.overview: A biopic of Malika Bellaribi, a French-Algerian woman who grew up in the Parisian projects, who survived trauma and ultimately achieved her dream of becoming a renowned lyrical singer.
items.title: Malika

items.overview: The film focuses on what it means to truly love someone "in sickness and in health." In the story, talented pianist Canan embarks on a passionate affair with Bekir, a mysterious agent, after saving his life. However, Bekir suddenly disappears. When he returns years later, he finds Canan married someone else. This encounter rekindles a love that had been interrupted years before. Canan is forced to make an impossible choice between her past passion and her present-day loyalty.
items.title: Last Dinner

items.overview: Longing for love and the promise of a better life, a grandmother finds herself swept into an unexpected online romance that challenges her sense of worth, family, and the dreams she refuses to let go of.
items.title: Status: Rejected

items.overview: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.
items.title: Guarding Stars

items.overview: Amid the isolation of the COVID-19 pandemic, Ricardo, a young film student, grapples with heartbreak and family tensions. As reality unravels, he retreats into imagined versions of the film he’s struggling to create—blurring the line between his script and his life.
items.title: Ricardo Remix Feat. COVID-19

items.overview: Vivek and his gang of friends embark on an attempt to create an ambitious survival film.
items.title: ENE Repeat

items.overview: Freshly elected, President Paul Archambault must face an unprecedented crisis: his Russian counterpart, the target of an attack, brandishes a nuclear ultimatum threatening an ally of France. Faced with the risk of military escalation, the president gathers his staff in the bunker of the Elysée. In the secrecy of the command post Jupiter, Paul will have to make a dizzying decision.
items.title: Jupiter

items.overview: Two small-town brothers are visited by an alien. Having crash-landed in the forests of Norrbotten, the visitor is named Roland. The brothers, Arne and Stefan, teach him everything important about life on Earth, including moonshine, hunting, and the mystery of love.
items.title: Arne Goes to Space

items.overview: Gold fever has gripped northern Niger. In search of the precious metal, and despite the risks, an army of researchers has invaded the sites of interest. While camps are set up and dismantled as rumours of new leads spread, Moussa and his companions are banking on the Ikazan vein.
items.title: Mountain of Gold

items.overview: When 39 people are killed prior to the European Cup at the Brussels Heysel stadium in 1985, the mayor's daughter and an Italian journalist are torn between their professional assignments, family, and human nature.
items.title: Heysel 85

items.overview: Seventeen-year-old Kim lives with her emotionally distant mother, mute younger brother, and strangers hiding in a secret room in their apartment at the Baltic coast. Vietnamese migrants regularly pass through their home as her mother, a key figure in a criminal network, runs human trafficking operations. When her mother's associate Luc defects to start a rival operation, Kim seizes her chance to prove herself to her mother. She navigates her first romance while entering a clandestine family business. As her good intentions drag her into a dark and brutal underworld that contradicts her sensitive nature, Kim begins to question the true costs of earning respect by crossing her own boundaries.
items.title: The Matriarch

items.overview: The friendship between two boys end when one finally admits they need to part ways.
items.title: And

items.overview: Silvio Bertolini has just retired after 40 years as an Accounting Manager. His reward? A pregnant daughter in Barcelona, a wife eager for a family trip, and a government that insists he is dead.
items.title: When I Existed

items.original_title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
items.overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
items.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping

items.overview: At a remote train station covered in heavy snow, a station master Gap-su is facing the last day of his life-long dedication to the station. Devastated by the sudden layoffs, Gap-su keeps waiting for his young replacement, who still hasn’t yet come. As the hush reigns throughout the station, Gap-su sees the breaking news that dozens of convicts escaped from the overturned prison bus, and just then, a young man walks into the station claiming himself as the one Gap-su has been waiting for.
items.title: White Blast

items.overview: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.
items.title: Madden

items.overview: Afghanistan, summer 2021. As the Taliban gradually seize control of the country, Leila, a young widow, arrives in Kabul. She begins working in a kitchen that she discovers is part of a Bacha Bazi house. Very young, androgynous boys there dance dressed as women before audiences of men. She meets Tamim, a Bacha whom she decides to help. She will try to save other young boys and leave the country before the city falls.
items.title: When She Hears the Bells

items.overview: In an alternate reality where housekeeping is officially the best job, an intern at the Ministry of Household Affairs must face a final test that will determine the future foundation of his world
items.title: The Cell

items.overview: Following her divorce, Olya is dividing up her assets and numbing her troubles with alcohol. On the night of her birthday, in a drunken state, she unleashes all her pent-up rage on her innocent twin sister. The next morning, her sister has vanished—and Olya discovers a thin, white dog in the house
items.title: White and Fluffy

items.overview: Following the death of her mother, and while struggling with the tragedy, Alyona lives a reclusive life in an old village house. Her peace is disrupted by the sudden return of her brother, Mitya, and his wife, Marina
items.title: Melting Ice

items.overview: On Broadway, the night lights up to sell. Amid flashes, advertisements, and glowing surfaces, the camera observes the intensities and flows of desire that move through images. An audiovisual essay that attempts to make audible what light keeps silent.
items.title: The Lure of Light

items.overview: WARNING! EXTRATERRESTRIAL SIGHTING!  Cork City has been invaded by an  extraterrestrial creature who's only after one thing: to find a new home.
items.title: Here and There

items.overview: experimental short
items.title: Serafima

items.overview: For a child, losing a beloved grandparent can be strange and incomprehensible. In this story, Daniel and his grandmother reconnect and relearn after the loss of his grandfather.
items.title: La Partida

items.overview: French-Canadian comic Mike Ward delivers an unapologetically honest set, from dating after divorce to living life to the fullest - one impulse at a time
items.title: Mike Ward: Modest

items.overview: A young movietalker attempts to prevent the end of the world via a collective collect call. A prequel to WAX OR THE DISCOVERY OF TELEVISION AMONG THE BEES, the first movie on the internet.
items.title: The Manhattan Projector

items.overview: Sanya, a guy from the provinces, inflicts severe injuries on a local thug named Shurup while defending himself. Shurup loses consciousness, and it becomes clear that his life is in danger. Sanya hopes for the best, but the next morning, there’s a knock at the door.
items.title: Look for It

items.overview: 17th century. Twelve years after setting sail on a sea voyage, Adriano — presumed dead — returns to Marta’s coastal home in an attempt to reclaim his past with her. Upon his return, he finds the house inhabited by her new husband, Costa — a kind man who welcomes him with open arms — and the couple’s mute son. In order to avoid destroying the family, Adriano conceals his identity, pretending to be a messenger.
items.title: Volta ao Mundo

items.overview: A solitary paraglider follows the spine of the Rocky Mountains, from the Mexican border all the way to the heart of Canada, moving forward only with the wind beneath his wing or the slow rhythm of his steps, over more than 3,000km. From the southern deserts where snakes glide through the dust to the vast Canadian forests watched over by bears, his journey gradually transforms into an inner quest for the true meaning of adventure. As the landscapes unfold and solitude deepens, he discovers that the greatness of a journey does not necessarily lie in the extreme, but in those simple moments when one feels alive, far from the world, suspended between earth and sky.
items.title: Behind the Rockies

items.overview: As recent heir of the Vandycorn company, Cash J. Butters explores cheaper ways to run the family business.
items.title: Vandycorn

items.original_title: KI - Die letzte Erfindung der Menschheit?
items.overview: Artificial intelligence is advancing at an unprecedented pace, raising alarming questions about the future of humanity. Featuring leading AI pioneers Geoffrey Hinton, Yoshua Bengio and Yann LeCun, this documentary explores the history of AI, its increasingly unpredictable capabilities and the growing risks of losing control over intelligent machines. Through insider accounts, scientific research and personal stories, it investigates the possibility of an AI takeover and asks whether humanity can still keep its most powerful creation under control.
items.title: KI - Die letzte Erfindung der Menschheit?

items.overview: Telling the story of the end of a love affair gives rise to something unexpected. Para Mì, by Caterina Bertini, began as a diary to come to terms with the end of a relationship, but gradually evolved into a photographic account of one of the most difficult periods in Cuba’s recent history.
items.title: Para Mì

items.overview: A mother and her son, deserted roads, the flight of birds. Beaches, hands, faces, flowers. Nature, cities and mechanical presences come together in Melma, by Maya Ivona Peiu and Alessia Cascone, to create a visual poem that slips into nightmare. A boy searches for his lost beloved in a post-apocalyptic world engulfed by sludge. He and she, nameless figures bound by a love that has run its course, of which only fragments and unrealized possibilities remain.
items.title: Melma

items.overview: What if AI were used not as a visual gimmick but as a human, therapeutic resource? In Lo scrittore di silenzi, a man in his seventies with ALS can communicate with the outside world only through an eye-tracking device, transferring his thoughts, memories and emotions onto a screen, accompanied by the sound his steady breathing in the background.
items.title: Lo scrittore di silenzi

items.original_title: A Space Love Story Against Oblivion
items.overview: In 1977, the Voyager probes left Earth carrying the Golden Record: a collection of images, sounds, music and greetings in fifty-five languages, an attempt to describe humankind to an unknown recipient, whose existence was uncertain, as was its ability to understand us.
items.title: A Space Love Story Against Oblivion

And there is one bizarre condition: if she ever wants to return, she must have a child to carry on the family line.
results.title: One Month

results.overview: Vibrant, colorful, and warm portrait of 47-year-old Sonia, who wants to leave her life as a sex worker behind and find a different means of making a living—no easy task in Madagascar, one of the poorest countries in the world, but Sonia is determined.
results.title: Mangabangabaka

results.overview: Twelve-year-old Kallpa has one big dream: to be chosen as Ñusta, the sacred princess in her Andean community's Winter Solstice Festival. However, she is barred from taking part because she was born in the body of a boy. As rigid traditions and growing rejection push her out, Kallpa finds a new home and family among a group of local trans women. Even while facing harsh prejudice, this close-knit group wraps Kallpa in real warmth and tenderness, giving her the room to figure out who she is and learn to love herself. Her journey becomes a quiet, resilient fight to live life on her own terms.
results.title: Princess

results.overview: Paris, June 2024. It's summer, it's Pride, but Maël is getting ghosted and Emilie just got dumped. Luckily, somewhere in the crowd, Maël meets Emilie and Emilie meets Maël.
results.title: sad pride generation

results.overview: After going through a period of anxiety, successful Irish comedian Chris Kent decides to forgo the internet in an attempt to reconnect with his family- all whilst writing a new show
results.title: Chris Kent Goes Offline

results.overview: Private Investigator Donald Anderson is hired to follow a woman believed to be having an  affair, but when he sees something that defies all explanation, his grasp on reality slips. The  further he gets in his investigation, the thinner the line between the real and the surreal  becomes.
results.title: Gomorrah

results.overview: A surprise birthday celebration turns into a waking nightmare when an enigmatic clown transforms a gathering of old friends into a series of disturbing performances, forcing each of them to confront the darkest truths they've hidden from one another.
results.title: Andoy

results.overview: A man unexpectedly meets his first love — a woman who died in a car accident three years earlier. Realising the past and present have become intertwined, he takes her on an impossible journey across Mongolia.
results.title: Snow in June

results.overview: When the Great Darkness returns to consume the world, Matilda, the daughter of the legendary King Adler, must journey through a realm swallowed by death and corruption. Armed only with her father's stories and an unbreakable will, she challenges an ancient force that has claimed countless lives, refusing to accept that death is the end.
results.title: She Who Refused Death

results.overview: The Fable of the Oplose follows two coworkers, Kellen and Rose, as they navigate life between shifts at a local restaurant. The story follows the 'magic' that holds the service industry together, exploring the tension of a workplace romance.
results.title: The Fable of the Oplose

results.overview: February 2026: Nerea, a young dreamer, arrives in the city where she meets Sael. Through voice memos recorded on the underground, streets and buildings, Nerea reflects on our place as human beings in the world. Nerea’s message will fall into Sael’s hands, thrown from the top of a skyscraper.
results.title: Vagar

results.overview: One chaotic, wild night in the streets of Cairo. The story revolves around a young man who is fiercely determined to chase his dream of becoming an entrepreneur and starting his own business. Alongside his friend and his cousin, his ambitious plans take an unexpected turn when their paths cross with a local taxi driver.
results.title: The Night Was Completely Ruined

results.overview: To avoid losing custody of her six-year-old daughter in Manila, Luz, an undocumented Filipina cleaner working in a luxury Swiss ski resort, must earn money at any cost – even if it means transgressing her own moral limits.
results.title: Enjoy Your Stay

results.overview: The beloved opera star Montserrat Caballé faces a challenge that takes her back to the beginning of her career.
results.title: Caballé

results.overview: Chronicles Shantaram Rajaram Vankudre, aka V. Shantaram, on his remarkable journey from the silent era through the advent of sound and colour, showcasing his evolution as one of India’s most influential filmmakers.
results.title: V. Shantaram

results.overview: A biopic of Malika Bellaribi, a French-Algerian woman who grew up in the Parisian projects, who survived trauma and ultimately achieved her dream of becoming a renowned lyrical singer.
results.title: Malika

results.overview: The film focuses on what it means to truly love someone "in sickness and in health." In the story, talented pianist Canan embarks on a passionate affair with Bekir, a mysterious agent, after saving his life. However, Bekir suddenly disappears. When he returns years later, he finds Canan married someone else. This encounter rekindles a love that had been interrupted years before. Canan is forced to make an impossible choice between her past passion and her present-day loyalty.
results.title: Last Dinner

results.overview: Longing for love and the promise of a better life, a grandmother finds herself swept into an unexpected online romance that challenges her sense of worth, family, and the dreams she refuses to let go of.
results.title: Status: Rejected

results.overview: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.
results.title: Guarding Stars

results.overview: Amid the isolation of the COVID-19 pandemic, Ricardo, a young film student, grapples with heartbreak and family tensions. As reality unravels, he retreats into imagined versions of the film he’s struggling to create—blurring the line between his script and his life.
results.title: Ricardo Remix Feat. COVID-19

results.overview: Vivek and his gang of friends embark on an attempt to create an ambitious survival film.
results.title: ENE Repeat

results.overview: Freshly elected, President Paul Archambault must face an unprecedented crisis: his Russian counterpart, the target of an attack, brandishes a nuclear ultimatum threatening an ally of France. Faced with the risk of military escalation, the president gathers his staff in the bunker of the Elysée. In the secrecy of the command post Jupiter, Paul will have to make a dizzying decision.
results.title: Jupiter

results.overview: Two small-town brothers are visited by an alien. Having crash-landed in the forests of Norrbotten, the visitor is named Roland. The brothers, Arne and Stefan, teach him everything important about life on Earth, including moonshine, hunting, and the mystery of love.
results.title: Arne Goes to Space

results.overview: Gold fever has gripped northern Niger. In search of the precious metal, and despite the risks, an army of researchers has invaded the sites of interest. While camps are set up and dismantled as rumours of new leads spread, Moussa and his companions are banking on the Ikazan vein.
results.title: Mountain of Gold

results.overview: When 39 people are killed prior to the European Cup at the Brussels Heysel stadium in 1985, the mayor's daughter and an Italian journalist are torn between their professional assignments, family, and human nature.
results.title: Heysel 85

results.overview: Seventeen-year-old Kim lives with her emotionally distant mother, mute younger brother, and strangers hiding in a secret room in their apartment at the Baltic coast. Vietnamese migrants regularly pass through their home as her mother, a key figure in a criminal network, runs human trafficking operations. When her mother's associate Luc defects to start a rival operation, Kim seizes her chance to prove herself to her mother. She navigates her first romance while entering a clandestine family business. As her good intentions drag her into a dark and brutal underworld that contradicts her sensitive nature, Kim begins to question the true costs of earning respect by crossing her own boundaries.
results.title: The Matriarch

results.overview: The friendship between two boys end when one finally admits they need to part ways.
results.title: And

results.overview: Silvio Bertolini has just retired after 40 years as an Accounting Manager. His reward? A pregnant daughter in Barcelona, a wife eager for a family trip, and a government that insists he is dead.
results.title: When I Existed

results.original_title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
results.overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
results.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping

results.overview: At a remote train station covered in heavy snow, a station master Gap-su is facing the last day of his life-long dedication to the station. Devastated by the sudden layoffs, Gap-su keeps waiting for his young replacement, who still hasn’t yet come. As the hush reigns throughout the station, Gap-su sees the breaking news that dozens of convicts escaped from the overturned prison bus, and just then, a young man walks into the station claiming himself as the one Gap-su has been waiting for.
results.title: White Blast

results.overview: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.
results.title: Madden

results.overview: Afghanistan, summer 2021. As the Taliban gradually seize control of the country, Leila, a young widow, arrives in Kabul. She begins working in a kitchen that she discovers is part of a Bacha Bazi house. Very young, androgynous boys there dance dressed as women before audiences of men. She meets Tamim, a Bacha whom she decides to help. She will try to save other young boys and leave the country before the city falls.
results.title: When She Hears the Bells

results.overview: In an alternate reality where housekeeping is officially the best job, an intern at the Ministry of Household Affairs must face a final test that will determine the future foundation of his world
results.title: The Cell

results.overview: Following her divorce, Olya is dividing up her assets and numbing her troubles with alcohol. On the night of her birthday, in a drunken state, she unleashes all her pent-up rage on her innocent twin sister. The next morning, her sister has vanished—and Olya discovers a thin, white dog in the house
results.title: White and Fluffy

results.overview: Following the death of her mother, and while struggling with the tragedy, Alyona lives a reclusive life in an old village house. Her peace is disrupted by the sudden return of her brother, Mitya, and his wife, Marina
results.title: Melting Ice

results.overview: On Broadway, the night lights up to sell. Amid flashes, advertisements, and glowing surfaces, the camera observes the intensities and flows of desire that move through images. An audiovisual essay that attempts to make audible what light keeps silent.
results.title: The Lure of Light

results.overview: WARNING! EXTRATERRESTRIAL SIGHTING!  Cork City has been invaded by an  extraterrestrial creature who's only after one thing: to find a new home.
results.title: Here and There

results.overview: experimental short
results.title: Serafima

results.overview: For a child, losing a beloved grandparent can be strange and incomprehensible. In this story, Daniel and his grandmother reconnect and relearn after the loss of his grandfather.
results.title: La Partida

results.overview: French-Canadian comic Mike Ward delivers an unapologetically honest set, from dating after divorce to living life to the fullest - one impulse at a time
results.title: Mike Ward: Modest

results.overview: A young movietalker attempts to prevent the end of the world via a collective collect call. A prequel to WAX OR THE DISCOVERY OF TELEVISION AMONG THE BEES, the first movie on the internet.
results.title: The Manhattan Projector

results.overview: Sanya, a guy from the provinces, inflicts severe injuries on a local thug named Shurup while defending himself. Shurup loses consciousness, and it becomes clear that his life is in danger. Sanya hopes for the best, but the next morning, there’s a knock at the door.
results.title: Look for It

results.overview: 17th century. Twelve years after setting sail on a sea voyage, Adriano — presumed dead — returns to Marta’s coastal home in an attempt to reclaim his past with her. Upon his return, he finds the house inhabited by her new husband, Costa — a kind man who welcomes him with open arms — and the couple’s mute son. In order to avoid destroying the family, Adriano conceals his identity, pretending to be a messenger.
results.title: Volta ao Mundo

results.overview: A solitary paraglider follows the spine of the Rocky Mountains, from the Mexican border all the way to the heart of Canada, moving forward only with the wind beneath his wing or the slow rhythm of his steps, over more than 3,000km. From the southern deserts where snakes glide through the dust to the vast Canadian forests watched over by bears, his journey gradually transforms into an inner quest for the true meaning of adventure. As the landscapes unfold and solitude deepens, he discovers that the greatness of a journey does not necessarily lie in the extreme, but in those simple moments when one feels alive, far from the world, suspended between earth and sky.
results.title: Behind the Rockies

results.overview: As recent heir of the Vandycorn company, Cash J. Butters explores cheaper ways to run the family business.
results.title: Vandycorn

results.original_title: KI - Die letzte Erfindung der Menschheit?
results.overview: Artificial intelligence is advancing at an unprecedented pace, raising alarming questions about the future of humanity. Featuring leading AI pioneers Geoffrey Hinton, Yoshua Bengio and Yann LeCun, this documentary explores the history of AI, its increasingly unpredictable capabilities and the growing risks of losing control over intelligent machines. Through insider accounts, scientific research and personal stories, it investigates the possibility of an AI takeover and asks whether humanity can still keep its most powerful creation under control.
results.title: KI - Die letzte Erfindung der Menschheit?

results.overview: Telling the story of the end of a love affair gives rise to something unexpected. Para Mì, by Caterina Bertini, began as a diary to come to terms with the end of a relationship, but gradually evolved into a photographic account of one of the most difficult periods in Cuba’s recent history.
results.title: Para Mì

results.overview: A mother and her son, deserted roads, the flight of birds. Beaches, hands, faces, flowers. Nature, cities and mechanical presences come together in Melma, by Maya Ivona Peiu and Alessia Cascone, to create a visual poem that slips into nightmare. A boy searches for his lost beloved in a post-apocalyptic world engulfed by sludge. He and she, nameless figures bound by a love that has run its course, of which only fragments and unrealized possibilities remain.
results.title: Melma

results.overview: What if AI were used not as a visual gimmick but as a human, therapeutic resource? In Lo scrittore di silenzi, a man in his seventies with ALS can communicate with the outside world only through an eye-tracking device, transferring his thoughts, memories and emotions onto a screen, accompanied by the sound his steady breathing in the background.
results.title: Lo scrittore di silenzi

results.original_title: A Space Love Story Against Oblivion
results.overview: In 1977, the Voyager probes left Earth carrying the Golden Record: a collection of images, sounds, music and greetings in fifty-five languages, an attempt to describe humankind to an unknown recipient, whose existence was uncertain, as was its ability to understand us.
results.title: A Space Love Story Against Oblivion
